description: issue #932, the CHECK half of the pair. `forward` is a Command (`spec/commands.md:1196,1198`: Kind Command, Result —), so a `map` body ending in it produces nothing and the block-result rule raises `ol-no-value` (`spec/execution-model.md:228-229`, `spec/error-model.md:115`) — exactly as the spec's own worked `map num in :nums [ print :num ]` example does (`spec/tooling.md:225-232`). Before this issue the classification was a hand-written three-name list (`print`/`show`/`randomize`) in `checker-control-flow.ts`, so this program checked SILENT while the `print` spelling of it errored; the comprehension is written in VALUE position because a statement-position `map` never evaluates its body, which hides the defect. Runs with `style: true` to also assert the fix adds no style finding here. The execute half of the pair is `command-body-no-value-execute`.
